categories.main_business_segments: Qingyan Environmental Technology is a specialized environmental technology company focused on rapid biochemical wastewater treatment. The company operates through three main business segments: wastewater treatment process package sales (including RPIR and T-Bic technology-based products), water treatment engineering services, and water treatment operational services. The company serves municipal wastewater treatment, industrial wastewater treatment, and distributed rural sewage treatment markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include RPIR (Rapid Purification of sewage using sedimentation Integrated rectangular airlift loop Reactor), T-Bic (Three-dimensional Biological Immobilized Curtain), and related variants such as MCBR (Modularized Circulation Bioreactor), limiting-oxygen RPIR, and anaerobic ammonia oxidation technology. These technologies integrate biochemical reaction, sedimentation separation, and biological enhancement into standardized modular equipment. The company employs a production model of order-based manufacturing with selective inventory of common components, utilizing both in-house production and outsourced processing for specialized components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves municipal governments and water utility enterprises as primary customers, including large state-owned enterprises, listed companies, and local water management platforms. End markets include municipal wastewater treatment plant construction and upgrades, black odorous water body remediation, rural distributed sewage treatment, industrial wastewater treatment (surface treatment, printing and dyeing, petrochemical, food processing), and water environment improvement projects. Geographic customer distribution spans South China, Central China, East China, and Southwest China regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily across mainland China with established presence in 28 provinces and autonomous regions. Major operating regions include South China (27.28% of 2024 revenue), Central China (19.90%), East China (44.44%), and Southwest China (8.38%). The company has established subsidiaries in multiple locations including Wuhan, Anqing, Beijing, Shanghai, Bashan, Zhoukou, Hainan, and Huaihua, with headquarters in Shenzhen.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the environmental treatment supply chain. It functions as a technology and equipment provider, designing and manufacturing standardized wastewater treatment modules and systems for integration into larger environmental infrastructure projects. The company also provides operational services for wastewater treatment facilities, positioning it between equipment manufacturing and end-user service delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous technology iteration and scene-based innovation, focusing on developing next-generation treatment technologies including MCBR modules with doubled processing capacity, T-Bic technology optimization for biofilm denitrification, and limiting-oxygen RPIR for high-ammonia wastewater. Strategic initiatives include expanding into industrial wastewater treatment, sludge resource utilization, hazardous waste treatment, and implementing a 'New Partnership Strategy' to establish collaborative innovation ecosystems. R&D investment in 2024 was 12.35 million yuan (16.87% of revenue), with focus on modular equipment upgrades and application scenario expansion.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through three channels: (1) wastewater treatment process package sales (70.94% of 2024 revenue), including design, equipment manufacturing, procurement, and installation of standardized treatment systems; (2) water treatment operational services (23.99% of revenue), including facility operation, optimization, diagnostics, and maintenance; and (3) water treatment engineering services (5.03% of revenue). Revenue is recognized upon customer acceptance and verification of treatment standards achievement, with payment terms typically involving progress-based billing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a technology innovation leader in rapid biochemical wastewater treatment, competing in a fragmented market with numerous traditional technology providers. The company differentiates through proprietary RPIR and T-Bic technologies offering advantages in land efficiency, construction speed, and operational cost. Key competitive advantages include modular standardization enabling rapid deployment, lower capital and operational costs compared to conventional methods, and expanding application scenarios. The company faces competition from both established environmental engineering firms and emerging technology providers, with competitive intensity increasing as the industry transitions from high-growth to consolidation phase.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized environmental technology enterprise with 2024 revenue of 73.17 million yuan, representing a significant 48.33% decline from 2023 revenue of 141.61 million yuan. The company reported a net loss of 18.22 million yuan in 2024 compared to net profit of 20.96 million yuan in 2023. Total assets stood at 931.01 million yuan at year-end 2024, with shareholders' equity of 807.11 million yuan. The company has approximately 129 employees and operates as a publicly listed company on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange (stock code 301288) since April 2022.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's core value proposition centers on providing rapid, modular, cost-effective wastewater treatment solutions that address industry pain points of high land requirements, long construction periods, and high operational costs. Key differentiators include: (1) RPIR technology eliminating secondary sedimentation tanks, reducing land footprint by 30-50%; (2) modular standardized equipment enabling flexible scaling and rapid deployment; (3) MCBR second-generation modules doubling processing capacity while reducing construction complexity; (4) integrated biochemical reaction and sedimentation in single reactors improving treatment efficiency; and (5) application versatility across municipal, industrial, and rural treatment scenarios. The company emphasizes technological innovation, scene-based customization, and ecosystem collaboration as sustainable competitive advantages.
